verdict.rationale: The repo ships its own AGENT.md, a first-party agent-oriented file listing commands such as `pnpm go`, `pnpm test:ai` and `pnpm eval`, so an agent can be pointed at it to set up or work on a self-hosted Zero. Its scope is codebase development only, and independent evidence says no docs site exists and the docs subdomains do not resolve. missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt, agent-oriented docs for using the product or its MCP/API surface (not just repo dev commands), a resolvable docs site, and hands-on corroboration that agents use AGENT.md effectively.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
